title: GRIMHOLLOW - Weather System Update
author: Novaworld7
selftext:
Howdy,

Saw a bunch of people posting and I figured I would post as well! First and foremost everyone keep up the great work! I love seeing all the great posts! 

I have always loved lineage 2, and have been terribly dissapointed with Ashes / TNL, so I have finally mustered up the courage to start building what I believe will scratch that itch. It has a few systems at its core which are going to be different but this is just about the wheather :D 

hope y'all like it, any feedback is good feedback. This is just a stationary view.

This is using a combination of things like purchaed assets from UE marketplace, and Astra / Fable / Opus to do all of the codiing and modifications, it does take a lot of gfoing back and forth with them to get this where it is, its 100% not a oneshot. 

Though they do help tremendously from the GDD / TDD / To implementation. it is amazing how AI is pushing things, I love it.
